annotations.text:
THREE HOME CONCEPTS — rebuilt under one rule after the last round: at most three zones per screen, no zone is a horizontal rail, and no zone repeats a list that another tab owns.
All three assume four tabs — Home / Map / Spaces / Account — and all three carry recommendations without a dashboard.
Colour is still Nightfall as a placeholder; the palette decision has not been made.
The map screen you approved, now recommendation-free and living in its own tab. Included so you can see the whole four-tab shape, not for review.
